text:
sara: Proposal: client-assisted reroute for A/B canaries. Clients emit tiny 'quality beacons' (latency p90, small error count, simple semantic score). Coordinator aggregates and issues signed override tokens. Clients may do a short local short-circuit if their local signal is catastrophic. Pros: faster local recovery; cons: noisy signals + extra trust surface. Thoughts?

mike: are clients just advisory or can they force a local switch?

sara: advisory by default. Flow: client -> beacon -> coordinator -> signed override broadcast. But client can do a temporary local short-circuit with backoff until a coordinator policy arrives.

alex: we need clear contracts: beacon schema, override token (signed + ttl + scope), audit log. Also idempotency keys on policy apply.

jen: security notes: scrub any PII, rate-limit beacons, require KMS-signed override tokens so clients only accept authentic policies.

sara: example beacon (stringified JSON in the payload):  {client:c-12, variant:A, wnd_s:20, p90_ms:300, errs:2, semantic:0.78}  (we'll hash session ids).

mike: quorum selection idea: reservoir sample per cohort and per-tenant thresholds to avoid noise and storms.

alex: use weighted-Bayesian detection: weight clients by reliability, compute posterior that quality < target, trigger when posterior > thresh. That lowers false positives.

jen: infra: coordinator must be async and backpressure-safe. Stream-aggregate into short-lived store (Redis) and emit policies. Bucket metrics for privacy.

sara: override token sketch: policy_id, action=fallback, target_variant, scope (cohort/region), ttl_s, signature=kms-v1, reason=posterior_xx, obs_ref(hash). Clients validate signature+scope+ttl.

mike: if some clients miss the policy (partition) they should reconcile periodically and have a safe revert after TTL. Also add proof-of-observation tokens for audits.

alex: add idempotency and avoid loops: policies must include a monotonic nonce and last-applied id.

jen: test plan: partitioned coordinator, malicious noisy clients, tenant isolation, ramp experiments. Metrics: false positive <1%, local short-circuit <10s, global policy <60s, audit coverage >=99%.

sara: next step: RFC follow-up with interface defs + minimal prototype (coordinator stateless front + Redis short store). tagging @mike @jen @alex.

ops-bot: created experiment cpe-88 on staging.

deploy-bot: deploy for cpe-88 OK — smoke passed.

mike: +1 to internal-only first, then slow ramp.

sara: thanks all, i'll draft RFC and include gating matrix.
